Algebra 1 · Unit 2: Solving Equations and Inequalities

Inequalities

Solve and graph inequalities, remembering to flip the sign when multiplying or dividing by a negative.

What you’ll learn

  • Solve one- and multi-step inequalities
  • Graph solutions on a number line
  • Solve and interpret compound inequalities
  • Write inequalities for real-world limits

The mountain biking connection

A trail must stay under a 10% grade: rise ÷ run ≤ 0.10 tells you the longest run a given rise needs.
